Mastermind of Multi-State Cyber Fraud Arrested After International Manhunt

Authorities have apprehended the alleged mastermind behind an 83-crore rupee multi-state cyber fraud scheme. Following a red-corner notice, Interpol assisted in the arrest of the individual in Dubai, from where they had fled after initially being in Thailand. Delhi Police successfully apprehended the suspect at the airport. Six individuals were initially held in connection with the cyber fraud racket.
